messages.subject: Project Lumen - DD and documentation timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Proposed timetable: legal and technical DD to run through December and into January, DD responses to us by mid-January, our first SPA draft out to you in early February, and completion targeted for the end of March. Our DD request list will follow separately to David.

Does that work for your side?

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
